text: I can't tell you whether to buy Tesla stock, because Albert Securities doesn't make investment recommendations. Keep in mind that the funds in Albert Savings are FDIC-insured up to $250,000 (on a pass-through basis, subject to certain limitations), and that protection only applies to deposits held at the partner bank, not to stock you buy. Our spending plan guidance also suggests saving at least 10% of your monthly income, so consider how much of your savings you'd want to keep accessible before moving any of it. If you're unsure, a licensed financial advisor can help you weigh your options.
